description: Toolly CI first-party trust boundary. Only Toolly-owned scripts and official GitHub-maintained actions pinned to full immutable commit SHAs are permitted in CI workflows.
notes: Community GitHub Actions are prohibited regardless of pinning.
Container actions (docker://) are prohibited regardless of digest pinning.
Mutable action references (tags, branches, HEAD) are prohibited.
Remote-script execution (curl|wget piped to shell, eval, dynamic pip/npm/npx installs) is prohibited.
All external CI dependencies must appear in the dependency registry.
This policy is enforced by scripts/validate_ci_trust_policy.py on every PR.
